svg.title: Product Recall Assistant architecture on Oracle AI Database 26ai
svg.desc: An editable architecture diagram showing recall data from suppliers, components, manufacturing, stores, customers, and complaints flowing into Oracle AI Database 26ai. The database uses relational, JSON, Spatial, SQL Property Graph, AI Vector Search, and PL/SQL features. Deep Data Security governs Select AI Agent, ORDS APIs, and a React/Node command center for store, regional, and recall lead users.

g.text: Events retain location, lot, and time
One governed engine for every recall data type and workload
The same transactional facts power every lab
Deep Data Security and least privilege
Store, Northeast region, and recall lead data roles filter rows before retrieval.
Agent tools and runtime accounts receive approved package access, not table access.
RECALL_OWNER | RECALL_APP_USER | DDS roles | audit evidence
120 stores | 2,400 units | 600 customers | 25 component batches | 25 supplier sites
Every channel uses approved database interfaces
Calls one approved PL/SQL tool before answering.
OCI Generative AI via resource principal
No arbitrary SQL | no customer PII
React UI | Node API | held DB session
role-scoped answer stored with secured context

svg.text: ONE GOVERNED DATABASE - SAME RECALL FACTS ACROSS JSON, SPATIAL, GRAPH, VECTOR, AGENT, SECURITY, AND REACT/NODE
Trace upstream component lots and downstream exposure without copying data into specialized stores
